transcript: Speaker A: मैं कचरा उठाती हूँ आज भी... [I still pick up trash today. 30 days ago, a mall guard threw me out when I asked for water, calling me illiterate. My daughter suggested I learn English to gain respect. I downloaded the 'English Seekho' app and practiced 10 minutes daily with its AI coach. 30 days later, I returned to the same mall, spoke fluent English, and received respect and a salute. If I can do it, so can you. Download the English Seekho app now.]

summary: A street sweeper narrates how she was humiliated at a mall for not knowing English. After using the English Seekho app's AI coach for 10 minutes a day, she returns to the mall, speaks fluent English, and is treated with respect. She urges viewers to download the app and take the 30-day challenge.
